reason: I only hire people another owner I know has used, and this lot are in Kuwait with no clients or reviews to show. Pay-on-approval is clever, but I'm not spending my staff's time briefing a stranger just because it costs nothing upfront.
objection: Nobody I know has used them, they've no track record, and if something breaks on my site next year I've no idea who I'd ring or whether they'll still be around.
would_change_my_mind: A local owner I trust telling me they built their site and it's been solid for a while.
